title: MCP Office Rename And Excel Local Server
goal: Rename the PPTX-only Office Files MCP to a PowerPoint-specific MCP, remove Pros-specific MCP command prefixes for reusable servers, and add a workspace-guarded local Excel MCP with confirmed write support.

currentFindings: packages/pros-cli/src/mcp-office-files.ts exposes only pptx_* tools while the server name is pros-mcp-office-files.
packages/pros-cli/src/mcp-docx-local.ts and packages/pros-cli/src/mcp-microsoft-graph.ts still use pros-mcp-* command names.
Microsoft Graph Excel support exists only for cloud DriveItem A1 range reads.
runtime/pros/pros-runtime-manifest.md and docs reference Pros Office Files MCP and pros-prefixed MCP commands.

constraints: Do not modify root .agents/ SSOT files unless the task explicitly requires agent-system changes.
Local file MCPs must enforce the workspace guard and must not upload file contents externally.
Write tools must require explicit confirmation and must create backups before modifying files.
Macro-enabled Excel files should be denied for write operations in V1.
Microsoft Graph Excel range reads must remain clearly documented as cloud/DriveItem functionality, separate from local Excel.

microsoftGraph.notes: Remove Pros-specific command prefix from user-facing reusable MCP command.

tasks.title: Inventory all affected MCP names and references
acceptanceCriteria: All command names, server IDs, provider IDs, docs, manifest, tests, and generated runtime references are listed.
Stale generic office-files references are categorized as internal implementation, provider ID, or user-facing text.

tasks.title: Finalize naming map and compatibility stance
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical names are docx-local, microsoft-graph, powerpoint-local, and excel-local.
Any retained legacy alias is explicitly justified and tested.

tasks.title: Rename Office Files MCP to PowerPoint Local MCP
acceptanceCriteria: The PPTX-only MCP server is named PowerPoint-specific in code, registry, manifest, docs, and tests.
PPTX tool names remain stable unless a deliberate migration is documented.

tasks.title: Remove Pros prefix from reusable MCP command names
acceptanceCriteria: DOCX, Microsoft Graph, and PowerPoint user-facing commands no longer start with pros-.
CLI entrypoints/package bins/config generation agree on the new commands.

tasks.title: Implement local Excel core module
acceptanceCriteria: Local .xlsx inspect, extract, and read-range functions exist with bounded outputs.
Edit preview and approved apply support cell-value updates with backup creation.
Path guard is enforced for every file operation.

tasks.title: Add mcp-excel-local stdio server
acceptanceCriteria: MCP tools xlsx_inspect, xlsx_extract, xlsx_read_range, xlsx_plan_edit, and xlsx_apply_approved_edit are registered.
Write apply requires confirmationStatus CONFIRMED and rejects stale previews.

tasks.title: Update integration registry and capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Registry exposes excel-local and powerpoint-local with correct capability metadata.
Graph Excel remains under microsoft-graph and is not merged with local Excel.

tasks.title: Update MCP client config generation
acceptanceCriteria: Managed keys, include parsing, expected commands, and status/preflight output use canonical names.
Config generation preserves unrelated foreign MCP entries.

tasks.title: Update CLI help and direct integration commands
acceptanceCriteria: CLI help separates local Excel from Microsoft Graph Excel.
DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX command surfaces are discoverable and consistently named.

tasks.title: Update runtime manifest and documentation
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime manifest, MCP command docs, credential docs, end-user docs, and runtime skill references use the new names.
No user-facing Pros Office Files MCP or generic office-files wording remains for the PPTX server.

tasks.title: Add and update tests
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover renamed commands, provider IDs, manifest entries, config output, Excel workbook operations, workspace guard denial, and confirmed write behavior.
Regression tests fail on stale pros-mcp-office-files references where user-facing PowerPoint naming is expected.

tasks.title: Run verification and stale-reference scan
acceptanceCriteria: Targeted unit tests, package test/typecheck/build, and stale-reference scans pass.
Generated runtime diff is reviewed for intentional changes only.

doneWhen: No user-facing Pros Office Files MCP remains; PowerPoint naming is explicit.
DOCX, Microsoft Graph, and PowerPoint reusable MCP commands no longer use the pros- prefix, except documented compatibility aliases if required.
excel-local exists as a workspace-guarded first-party MCP with inspect, extract, read-range, preview edit, and confirmed apply.
Excel writes are confirmation-gated, backup-producing, bounded, and macro-write safe.
Runtime manifest, docs, config generation, CLI help, and tests agree on canonical names.
Verification catches stale references to pros-mcp-office-files, Pros Office Files MCP, and generic user-facing office-files wording.

decisionLog.decision: Treat this as a Complex plan.
decisionLog.rationale: The work touches naming, MCP contracts, CLI entrypoints, config generation, docs, runtime manifest, tests, and a new local Excel write-capable server.

decisionLog.decision: Use MCP tool contracts instead of HTTP API contracts.
decisionLog.rationale: The integration boundary is stdio MCP server/tool schemas consumed by agent clients.

decisionLog.decision: Use oma-backend for first-party implementation and mcp-config-sync for client config propagation guidance.
decisionLog.rationale: The server is maintained inside the existing TypeScript CLI package, not installed from an external catalog.

verification: Run targeted tests for mcp servers, integration registry, MCP client config, CLI help, and Excel local module.
Run package typecheck/build/test commands discovered from package scripts.
Scan for stale user-facing references after rename.
